checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.why: Dark sky, lit windows and lamps.

must.item: Street and shop architecture retain shapes/positions
must.why: Layout is preserved; upper buildings are darkened and some details such as the planters and the shop signs are lost or changed.

must.item: Pedestrian on right same pose and blue jacket
must.why: The man is in the same place, pose and jacket.
Lighting is plausible, with warm windows, a lamp glow and headlights, and there are no daylight shadows.
A new woman in dark clothes stands in front of the left shop door, and a car with headlights now sits in the street.

faults.what: A new pedestrian was added at the left shop door, which the user did not ask for.
Shop sign text and details were changed, and the planters and flowers were removed.
A car with bright headlights was added on the road in place of the original parked cars.

summary: A convincing night version that keeps the layout and the man, but it adds a new woman at the left shop door and changes some details.
